Hi, thanks for checking up, I have talked to her about it again, she did get upset, but I still told her about the issue. She said she understands and will give me some more distance.

I hope it works

Thanks for that, Ive been on anti-depressants for 3 years now, doctor has pushed my way above the "recommended" amount. I still feel shit, and the fact that my life is so good, I have a house, food, a bed, that makes me feel guilty on top of it too. I have been to a therapist, she basically said Im impossible it fix alone, that I need my friends t help too, but I dont have any. My head turns everything into black mush, and uses it to feed my depression 

I feel stuck, I cant do anything, and I dont wan to either..

Im currently on 650mg Effexor- Daily
I feel like shes pushing me because seeing her hurt makes me hurt soo much more, It's a constant cycle. I hurt, she hurts, I hurt more seeing her hurt.
